title: Stage 13 pre-registration: what the middle layers hold if not the name
status_at_writing: M1, M2, M2b already ran (qualitative predictions in report Part IV v1, 07:15); M2c submitted, no output yet; M3, X1, X3, X4 have produced no data (0/144 GPU units). Numbers below are frozen before any of their data exist.
general_rules: All layers and positions are reported; no result is reported for a hand-picked layer only.

X1/X3/X4 use the paper-level tune/test split in config/pairs.parquet (50/50 within target and control). Any layer or position choice is made on tune; the confirmatory number is the test-split value at that choice.
Intervals: 95% bootstrap over papers (2,000 draws). A difference counts only if its interval excludes 0.
Tolerance or parity misses are recorded as WARN and do not stop or change the analysis.
X2 gets its own addendum to this file before it runs.

M2c.metric: R^2 (year, log citations, log citations with the year removed) and AUROC within citation bin (recognised); BERT best layer vs Qwen last-title-token residual at L16-L60
M2c.style_explanation_if: BERT best-layer value >= Qwen best-layer value - 0.05
M2c.beyond_style_if: Qwen best-layer value exceeds BERT best-layer value by >= 0.10 (R^2) or >= 0.05 (AUROC)

M3.identity_index: I(l,pos) = mean cos(same paper, task a vs task b) - mean cos(different papers, task a vs task b), residuals centred per task and layer; averaged over the 3 task pairs
M3.transfer: T(l) = R^2 of a probe trained on task a and tested on task b, divided by R^2 trained and tested on b (year, log citations, field accuracy), 5-fold by paper
M3.H2_paper_identity_predicts: I(l) > 0 at the last title token from L8-L24 on, and T(l) >= 0.8 at L16-L40
M3.H1_task_predicts: I(l) near 0 (interval includes 0 or < 0.02) at L8-L24, or T(l) < 0.5 at L16-L40

X1.recovery: R(source,l) = mean(patched - corrupt) / mean(clean - corrupt) of A's first-author score; sources: authors, year, field (A's states) and random_c (C's state)
X1.layer_choice_on_tune: the layer with the largest R(authors,l) - R(random_c,l)
X1.task_independent_identity_if: on test at that layer: R(year) and R(field) each exceed R(random_c) (interval of the difference excludes 0) and are each within 0.1 of R(authors)
X1.task_specific_if: R(authors) - R(random_c) > 0 but R(year) - R(random_c) and R(field) - R(random_c) intervals include 0
X1.null_check: R(random_c,l) is expected near 0 at every layer; if it exceeds 0.1 anywhere, every recovery is reported relative to it and flagged

X3.gap: G(l,pos) = cos(original, paraphrase) - cos(original, partner) at each layer
X3.paper_identity_from_layer: the first layer whose G exceeds G at L4 (interval of the difference excludes 0), chosen on tune, confirmed on test
X3.behaviour: first-author score: paraphrase - partner > 0 (the model still recognises the paper under new words)
X3.inclusion: only paraphrases that pass the automatic checks and the manual spot check (logs/para_ok)

X4.decodability: D(answer,pos,l) = mean score(self source) - mean score(partner source), answers: year, first author, field; sources from the no-year authors prompt
X4.earliest_layer: the first layer with D's interval above 0, found on tune, confirmed on test
X4.H2_order_predicts: earliest layer for year and field <= earliest layer for first author
X4.recognition_predicts: D_year and D_author larger for target than control within citation bin (interval excludes 0)
X4.note: the year never appears in the source prompt, so D_year > 0 can only come from the model recognising the paper

X5.what: for each layer: paper identity retrievable across tasks (M3, top-1 retrieval among the test papers), first-author token by probe (M2/E4b), name by lens (Stage 10)
X5.H2_predicts: identity earliest, then author-by-probe, then name-by-lens (L57-61)
